evals.prompt: I uploaded a screen recording of Spotify's onboarding flow on iOS. Can you analyze it and document the flow?
evals.expected_output: Markdown report + Mermaid diagram identifying onboarding screens (welcome, value prop, permissions, account setup, completion). Each screen should have type, key components, and primary interaction. Mermaid diagram should show the flow with labeled transitions.
expectations: Extracts frames from video using ffmpeg
Each screen has: type, key components, primary interaction
Generates a valid Mermaid flowchart TD diagram
Generates a markdown report following the template
Mermaid file presented first, markdown second

evals.prompt: Here are 6 screenshots of a checkout flow from an e-commerce site. Please analyze the flow and create documentation.
evals.expected_output: Markdown report + Mermaid diagram identifying checkout screens (cart, shipping, payment, review, confirmation). Screenshots analyzed directly without ffmpeg. Flow type classified as Checkout/Purchase.
expectations: Does NOT attempt ffmpeg extraction (input is images, not video)
Each screen card has type, components, interaction
Mermaid diagram includes decision points where applicable

evals.prompt: Analyze this short 8-second screen recording of a login flow on a banking app.
evals.expected_output: Should extract at higher fps (2fps) due to short duration. Identify login-related screens. Classify as Authentication flow.
expectations: Adjusts ffmpeg fps for short video (higher than default)
Handles potentially few unique frames gracefully
Produces both Mermaid and Markdown outputs
